description: Diagram. Render a diagram via GET. Use type (mermaid, d2, …), query (source code), and format=png for ChatGPT. POST uses diagram_type and diagram_source instead. Credit cost: 5 credits per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Use png so ChatGPT can display the image. svg is for download or infinite scale. Allowed values: svg, png, jpeg, pdf. Default: "svg".

share.description: If true, persist the result and return share URLs instead of an image. Leave false to get the image.

type.description: Diagram language. Allowed values: mermaid, graphviz, plantuml, d2, svgbob, nomnoml, blockdiag, seqdiag, actdiag, nwdiag, bpmn, erd, excalidraw, ditaa, vega, vegalite, wavedrom, wireviz, c4plantuml, structurizr, tikz, pikchr, umlet, symbolator, packetdiag, rackdiag, bytefield, dbml. Default: "mermaid".

name: diagram
title: Diagram
